## Version history and recovery

Contract version 1 records the exact semantic/sync/descriptor/API/ABI/dialect tuple. Unknown tuples remain inert recoverable bytes; imported claims never authorize editing. Preserve backups and reopen with a compatible implementation. Do not clear documents or silently downgrade schemas. FIT-1.2/1.3 schema/producer tests are historical metadata evidence; PIN-1.3 browser cases qualify only their own packed consumer. See the source manifest for both identities.
